Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 자신과 잘 맞지 않는 의뢰였다고 한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Having failed the quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> notes that it wasn't a good fit for her.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、自分とは合わない依頼だったと言う。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>说那项委托不太适合自己。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說那項委託不太適合自己。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Ayant échoué la quête, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> note que ce n'était pas une bonne mission pour elle.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem die Quest fehlgeschlagen ist, bemerkt <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, dass sie nicht gut zu ihr passte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Habiendo fallado la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> comenta que no era una misión adecuada para ella.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após falhar na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> comenta que não era uma missão adequada para ela.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ผู้ที่ทำภารกิจล้มเหลว <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> บอกว่ามันเป็นภารกิจที่ไม่เหมาะกับเธอค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah gagal dalam misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> berkomentar bahwa misi itu tidak cocok untuknya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi thất bại nhiệm vụ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> nói rằng nhiệm vụ này không hợp với cô ấy.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: क्वेस्ट में असफल होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने कहा कि यह उसके लिए सही नहीं था।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: これでも飲んで、元気出して。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Tiens. Bois ça et reprends du poil de la bête.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Hier. Trink das und muntere dich auf.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 실패에도 불구하고 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 기분은 그리 나쁘지 않아 보인다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Despite the failure, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> didn't seem too upset.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 失敗したにも関わらず、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の機嫌はそう悪くなさそうだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然失败，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的心情看起来还是不错。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然失敗，<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的心情看起來還是不錯。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Même en cas d'échec, le moral de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ne faiblit pas.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Trotz der Niederlage scheint <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>s Stimmung nicht allzu schlecht zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Incluso si fallas, el ánimo de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> no parece decaer.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Mesmo com o fracasso, a sorte de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> não parece diminuir.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะล้มเหลว แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังดูไม่สิ้นหวัง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun gagal, suasana hati <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tampaknya tidak terlalu buruk.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Thất bại cũng chẳng sao, vận mệnh của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn chưa hề thay đổi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: असफलता के बावजूद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ज़्यादा परेशान नहीं लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> pouted, clearly bothered by her failure.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、失敗したことが心に引っかかっているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎对未能完成委托耿耿于怀。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎對未能完成委託耿耿於懷。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a fait la moue, visiblement agacée par son échec.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> scheint das Scheitern der Quest zu beschäftigen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece estar molesta por haber fallado la misión.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecia incomodada com o fracasso da missão.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนว่าความล้มเหลวในภารกิจจะยังคงค้างคาใจเธออยู่ค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Tampaknya <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> merasa terganggu oleh kegagalan misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> có vẻ vẫn còn bận tâm về việc nhiệm vụ thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> को अपनी असफलता से परेशानी हो रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取ると感謝の気持ちを表した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a reçu un philtre et a exprimé sa gratitude.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> recibió el elixir y mostró gratitud.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> recebeu uma poção e demonstrou gratidão.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้รับพิษและแสดงความขอบคุณ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menerima ramuan itu dan mengucapkan terima kasih.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã nhận lấy phần thưởng và thể hiện lòng biết ơn.
